props.name: version
props.description: The release being announced. Stored as the last version seen.

props.name: pages
props.description: One page per highlight. Three or four is plenty.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is showing. Omit to let the component decide from storage.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called whenever the dialog closes, however it was closed.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: localStorage key for the last version seen. When set and `open` is omitted, the dialog opens by itself for a version this browser has not seen.

props.name: onDontShowAgain
props.description: Called on close when “Don’t show release notes” was ticked.

props.name: changelogHref
props.description: A link to the full changelog, shown on the last page.
